Description
 A cross-team Product & Engineering organization responsible for developing scalable green mobility and driver advisory solutions that support train operators in improving punctuality, reducing energy consumption, and moving toward zero-emission rail operations. The department collaborates closely with internal stakeholders, railway operators and Hitachi Rail partners to ensure products fit real-world operational contexts, align with global sustainability goals, and integrate into the wider Hitachi Rail product ecosystem
Short background of the stack
Backend: 95% C# with asp.net core, C# med asp.net framework and a custom extension in Java.
Frontend: C# with either Maui blazor or asp.net core + signal r + typescript
Hosting: VMs in azure or customer hosted – future will be containers on linux.
Deployment: Linux docker containers, legacy windows services, with misc oss/cots products (mssql, postgres, hivemq, traefik, keycloak)
 Requirements
Relevant education in Information Technology, Computer Science, Infrastructure Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure services and Cloud architecture
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, including CI/CD pipelines
Experience with Infrastructure as a Code using Terraform
Experience deploying, operating, and troublshooting contaierized applications in cloud environments
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machines, networking, storage, and identity services
Understanding of cloud security principles, governance, and compliance requirements
Experience with monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost management
Experience working in Agile/Scrum Environments
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
Commitment to continious improvement, automation, operational excllence, and professional development
 Job responsibilities
As a DevOps Engineer, you are responsible for delivering and maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable cloud platforms and infrastructure. You will work closely with software developers and product teams to automate deployments, improve operational efficiency, and ensure high availability of business critical services. Through cloud engineering, infrastructure automation, security and continious improvement, you will enable theefficient delivery and operation of our products and services, while staying cost conscious aiming the reduce cost, while not compromising on development efficiency.
Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure and platform services in Microsoft Azure
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
Manage Infrastructure as a Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform
Administer and optimize Docker-based workloads running on Azure Virtual Machines
Ensure platform availability, performance, reliability, and operational stability
Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions
Apply security best practices, including identity management, access control, vulnerability management, and compliance requirements
Drive cloud governance, cost optimization, and FinOps initiatives
Collaborate with software developers, architects, and stakeholders to improve development and deployment processes
Troubleshoot infrastructure, application, and deployment-related issues
Maintain technical documentation, standards, and operational procedures
Identify and drive improvements through autoamtion, standartization, and adoption of modern DevOps practicies
Share knowledge and contribute to building a strong engineering culture
Business trips to Copenhagen will be required for onboarding (2 weeks) and later – once per quarter
